model_output.verdict: Your B2B software marketing work points toward the Tallgrass role. I’d hesitate to move this resume forward because it names the tools but leaves your hands-on work with them unclear. What have you built in HubSpot?
write_up: Your Brightfield Software role puts you close to the email, webinar and reporting work Tallgrass needs. This is a common coordinator resume pattern: the activities are there, but your part in them and the results are often left out. That makes it difficult to tell how much of the marketing operations work you’ve done yourself.

The regional broker events line is a useful model because it names the pages and forms you updated and what they were for. Your resume also lists HubSpot, Salesforce and Google Analytics 4, but doesn’t connect those tools to the work in your roles.

Let’s start with the Brightfield newsletter and work down through the webinars, calendar and reports. Add what you handled, the tools you used and any numbers or results you can substantiate. That will give Tallgrass a better view of your fit without claiming work you haven’t done.
